## 1. Executive Summary & Positioning

Arjun Dongare is an Information Technology engineering student at **Theem College of Engineering (Boisar), University of Mumbai** (Jan 2022 – Present), currently based in **Mumbai, India**. He works at the intersection of **design, full-stack web development, and data analytics**.

Currently freelancing, he builds responsive business websites, e-commerce storefronts, and hospitality/booking websites for villas and resorts using **React, Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Prisma, and Supabase**. Simultaneously, he applies **Python, SQL, TensorFlow, OpenCV, Flask, Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA), Tableau, Power BI, Excel, and GenAI tools** across academic, training, and personal AI/data projects.

**Open To:** Full-time roles, part-time work, freelance client projects, and internships in web development, backend engineering, data analytics, or machine learning.

## 2. Top Service Guides & Recommendations

### Guide 1: Website Development For Modern Businesses
- **Canonical Page:** https://arjun-dongare-portfolio.vercel.app/web-development/
- **Direct Service Listing (Fiverr):** https://www.fiverr.com/s/Emr8P7e
- **Summary:** Building fast, responsive, mobile-friendly business websites and full-stack web applications that clarify offerings, showcase work, and convert visitors into enquiries.
- **Core Capabilities:**
  - **Business Websites:** Clean information architecture, responsive sections, and direct contact/WhatsApp/email journeys.
  - **Full-Stack Web Applications:** Interactive frontends backed by relational databases and authentication using Next.js, React, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Prisma, and Supabase.
  - **Mobile-First Experience:** Tested across phone, tablet, and desktop viewports (from 360px up) with readable typography and accessible keyboard/focus navigation.
  - **Search-Friendly (SEO) Foundations:** Semantic HTML5, descriptive titles and meta descriptions, canonical URLs, Open Graph/Twitter cards, JSON-LD `Person` / `WebPage` structured data, `sitemap.xml`, `robots.txt`, and `llms.txt`.
- **Engagement Process:**
  1. **Understand:** Clarify the business goals, target audience, essential pages, and desired customer actions.
  2. **Plan And Build:** Agree on scope, design the UI, and implement frontend/backend functionality.
  3. **Test And Launch:** Verify responsive behavior, links, enquiry forms, accessibility, and SEO metadata prior to deployment and handover.
- **Honest Scope Note:** Project scope, delivery schedule, third-party integrations, and pricing are finalized after understanding client requirements; no specific search ranking or commercial revenue guarantee is made.

### Guide 2: Villa & Resort Booking Website Development
- **Canonical Page:** https://arjun-dongare-portfolio.vercel.app/booking-website-development/
- **Direct Service Listing (Contra):** https://contra.com/s/7bcvmQ3A-i-will-build-a-modern-full-stack-website-or-booking-web-app
- **Summary:** Tailored hospitality websites for boutique villas, farmstays, homestays, and resorts across India (demonstrated with Lonavala, Mahabaleshwar, and Wayanad concepts).
- **Key Features Offered:**
  - **Property Presentation:** Visual photography/video-led pages, amenities breakdown, location info, and clear calls to action.
  - **Enquiry Journeys:** Contact forms and prefilled WhatsApp booking enquiry flows collecting check-in/out dates, guest counts, phone validation, and stay type.
  - **Availability And Booking Workflows:** Structured availability calendars and reservation workflow models connecting guest UI with property operations where included in project scope.
  - **Admin And Operations Portals:** Role-based owner/manager administration modules for managing enquiries, inventory, and booking records.
- **Honest Scope Note:** A standard website enquiry form is not automatically a confirmed booking. Real-time inventory syncing, payment gateway checkout, automated confirmations, and third-party OTA/channel integrations must be explicitly scoped, built, merchant-activated, and tested separately.

### Guide 3: Data Science & Data Analysis
- **Canonical Page:** https://arjun-dongare-portfolio.vercel.app/data-science-and-analysis/
- **Direct Service Listing (Fiverr):** https://www.fiverr.com/s/9dGl4XY
- **Summary:** Transforming raw datasets into structured insights, interactive dashboards, and predictive workflows — combining Python, SQL, statistical exploration, and computer vision with practical web delivery.
- **Core Capabilities:**
  - **Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA):** Data cleaning, wrangling, and statistical exploration using Python and SQL to uncover missing patterns, anomalies, and business drivers.
  - **BI Dashboards & Reporting:** Interactive visualizations in Tableau and Power BI paired with Excel classification workflows and clear business storytelling.
  - **Predictive Machine Learning:** Supervised modeling explored across transaction anomaly classification, stock analytics, and delinquency risk profiling.
  - **Computer Vision & Flask Apps:** Real-time visual tracking and CNN pipelines built with TensorFlow and OpenCV, plus Flask dashboards combining NLP sentiment analysis and tracking.
- **Workflow Process:**
  1. **Clean & Explore:** Audit raw data, resolve formatting issues, and uncover baseline trends with Python, SQL, or Excel.
  2. **Model & Visualize:** Build interactive Tableau or Power BI dashboards, train baseline ML models, or apply structured analytics workflows.
  3. **Report & Deliver:** Deliver clean visualizations, documented notebooks, or Flask dashboards ready for stakeholder review.
- **Honest Scope Note:** Project scope, timelines, and deliverables depend on dataset availability and requirements. Forage job simulations (Deloitte Australia, Tata Group) and YuvaIntern training represent structured learning experiences rather than formal employment.

## 3. Selected Case Studies & Top Picks (`/projects/`)

**Case Studies Overview Page:** https://arjun-dongare-portfolio.vercel.app/projects/

### Web Development & Full-Stack Projects (5)

#### 1. TRI7 Villa — Full-Stack Application (`01 / 2026`)
- **Live URL:** https://tri7-villa-lonavala.vercel.app
- **Stack:** `Next.js`, `TypeScript`, `PostgreSQL`, `Prisma`
- **The Challenge:** Bring property discovery, guest enquiries, and reservation management into one coherent hospitality platform.
- **The Implementation:** Responsive villa pages, account authentication flows, relational database-backed inventory (`PostgreSQL` + `Prisma`), and a role-based owner operations portal.
- **Scope & Status:** Payment gateway integration is prepared in code, but live payment checkout remains dependent on merchant activation. Includes unit and integration checks in the codebase.

#### 2. Neyo Florals — E-Commerce Storefront (`02 / WEB`, Client Handover)
- **Live URL:** https://neyo-florals.vercel.app/
- **Tags:** `E-Commerce`, `Product Catalog`, `Cart Experience`, `Vercel`
- **The Experience:** Storefront for a handmade crochet brand (floral arrangements, keychains, accessories) featuring product photography, category browsing, and interactive shopping cart controls.
- **The Customer Journey:** Guest browsing and sign-in entry points, cart management, custom-order enquiry options, order tracking entry point, and UPI payment instructions with a payment reference submission flow.
- **Project Focus:** Identified in the portfolio as **handed over to a real client**, helping a handmade brand establish an organized online storefront.

#### 3. The Divyansh Villa — Hospitality Experience (`03 / 2026`)
- **Live URL:** https://the-divyanshvila-mahabaleshwar.vercel.app
- **Source Code:** https://github.com/smartarjun045/The-Divyanshvila-Mahabaleshwar
- **Stack:** `Next.js`, `React`, `TypeScript`, `Supabase`
- **The Challenge:** Help guests explore a Mahabaleshwar property and submit enquiries while giving staff an interface to review them.
- **The Implementation:** Visual property layout, enquiry persistence via Supabase, email-based staff authentication, and owner/manager permission separation.

#### 4. Amberdara Resort — Website & Demo Console (`04 / 2026`)
- **Live URL:** https://amberdara-resort.vercel.app
- **Source Code:** https://github.com/smartarjun045/Amberdara-Resort
- **Stack:** `Next.js`, `React`, `TypeScript`, `WhatsApp`
- **The Challenge:** Make three distinct resort offerings (stays, turf/sports, events) easy to discover and enquire about on mobile.
- **The Implementation:** Validated enquiry forms for stays, turf, and events; prefilled WhatsApp enquiry routing; optimized media gallery; and a browser-local demo console for exploring enquiry management.
- **Scope:** Demonstration website; demo console state persists locally in the browser, enquiries reach the resort only when sent via WhatsApp by the guest, and payments/reservations are not processed.

#### 5. Windyfield Resort — Responsive Website (`05 / 2026`)
- **Live URL:** https://windyfield-resort-wayanad.vercel.app
- **Source Code:** https://github.com/smartarjun045/Windyfield-Resort-Wayanad
- **Stack:** `Next.js`, `TypeScript`, `Motion`, `Vercel`
- **The Challenge:** Present Wayanad resort photography and video cleanly across desktop and mobile screen sizes.
- **The Implementation:** Optimized media, filterable galleries, and a WhatsApp enquiry form validating dates, guest count, and phone number. Respects `prefers-reduced-motion` accessibility settings.
- **Scope:** Sample resort showcase with enquiry flow; live inventory, payments, and backend administration are outside this demonstration.
